messages:
maya (pm): FYI got a firm ask from ACME: they want per-route daily budgets and the ability to route to cheaper quantized variants automatically. framing is renewal-driven; they said competitors are offering this as a commercial control.

sam (sales): they phrased it as 'must-have for our contract' — asking for a pilot.

oliver (design): clarifying q: do they need a full UI or would API/manual setup be ok for an initial validation?

tj (eng): backend work required. summary of needs: policy table per-tenant -> route mapping to variant, enforcement of token/day caps, telemetry hooks for billing. Can do API-only MVP.

anika (infra): technical note: per-tenant routing will fragment shared caches; we should expect increased KV cache misses unless we shard or relax keying. also consider retention/volume of pilot logs.

maya (pm): suggested approach: API-first pilot (engineers apply configs for ACME), no UI, automated fallback to default variant when cap hit. this keeps scope small and validates demand.

tj (eng): rough spike: 3d policy wiring + 2d tests/telemetry + 1d ops/runbook. rollout: feature-flagged pilot, single tenant, 2-week observation window.

sam (sales): ACME wants pilot this week. is that doable?

maya (pm): EOW is aggressive. offer manual-config pilot this week, automated API pilot early next week.

oliver (design): for manual pilot i'll prepare a tiny config template to hand the customer.

maya (pm): example config we'll use: 

```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-1",
  "routes": [
    {"path": "/api/chat", "variant": "gptq-6b", "daily_token_cap": 300000},
    {"path": "/api/summarize", "variant": "base-13b", "daily_token_cap": 150000}
  ],
  "fallback_variant": "default-1"
}
```

tj (eng): fallback behavior: when cap reached -> rewrite request to fallback_variant + emit `cap_hit` event. billing system will reconcile.

anika (infra): telemetry keys to add: ["tenant_id","routing.variant","cap_hit","fallback_count"]. we should keep pilot logs for 30 days but aggregated metrics for 90d.

maya (pm): pilot acceptance criteria: (1) manual config applied for ACME, (2) console shows cap usage + fallback rate, (3) rollback documented and tested, (4) default traffic SLOs unchanged.

tj (eng): i'll open a PR for the policy table POC and link here. tagging @maya @anika.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature/per-route-budget -> staging (build 5892) :shipit:

sam (sales): if pilot signals positive we'll prioritize UI + billing integration next cycle. ACME will need a short SLA note clarifying quality/latency differences if routed to quantized variants.

maya (pm): add that to pilot brief. also flag security review but low surface since config is operator-managed.

tj (eng): marking `prio:urgent` for the week. will update thread with PR link and staging logs.

oliver (design): will share one-pager + config snippet after standup.

maya (pm): TL;DR: manual-config pilot this week, API-first automated pilot next week; if signal strong, Q3 scope = UI + billing automation + per-tenant cache tuning. thanks all :rocket:
